data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 18.6 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to improvements of GBP 18.8 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 1.1 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 1.3 million on property reinsurance.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Severe freeze and snow in Texas causing significant insured losses; affected the 2021 year of account and contributed to prior years' provisions.
Major hurricane causing material insured losses (reported ~ $40bn); affected the 2021 year of account and related reserves.
Series of late-season tornados in the US mid-west and a wildfire in Denver in late December 2021; contributed to 2021 year exposures and reserves.
Major geopolitical event in early 2022; the syndicate had limited exposure and the majority of allocated reserves for this loss sat within the 2021 year of account.

named_events.loss_description: Total insured loss from SCS events was estimated to be $60 billion (with eighteen individual events each greater than $1 billion).
Snow and severe freeze that caused around $15 billion of damage; affected 2021 year of account.
Estimated loss of around $40 billion; affected 2021 year of account.
October 2023 attack; syndicate has some very limited exposure to a number of assets in Israel which will be reduced over time if hostilities continue.
Continued conflict dominated headlines in 2022; syndicate had limited exposure which have now expired, with majority of allocated reserves sitting within the 2021 year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2023 were GBP 245.65m. During 2023 the syndicate recorded an overall release on prior years' provisions of GBP 18.6m (7.6% of opening reserves), driven by favourable development in casualty (-GBP 18.8m) and marine (-GBP 1.1m) lines, partially offset by an adverse movement on property (+GBP 1.3m). The movement is recorded as a release of reserves overall and is reflected in the technical provisions and associated notes.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding gross) and prior year movement taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which explicitly states a gross improvement of GBP 18.6m. A gross claims development triangle is present (covers UW years 2021-2023) and was used for cross-checking. No gross quantified syndicate-level loss amounts were provided for named catastrophes; amounts quoted in the report are industry-wide insured loss estimates.
